author: MegaBuilds
description:
17 years ago, NASA deliberately crashed a rocket into a crater on the moon. Dr Colaprete’s team had confirmed the existence of large quantities of water deep within the moon’s craters. 
And now, for the first time, the moon’s water is finally within reach… But who will get there first?

So let's dive into a story about superpowers, rockets… and the most expensive puddle in our solar system.
